maria (Marketing): Hey @alex — prepping the launch blog and a press claim. We need a minimal repro package + a quick quantized smoke run for embedding+generation numbers. Can runtime provide by EOD Wed: 1) the 10 sample payloads we used for the marketing bench, 2) warmup protocol we ran, 3) p50/p90/p99 latency and tokens/sec for the quantized variant, and 4) raw artifacts (one trace per slice)?

alex (Eng Runtime): Quick clarifying q's — which model id/quant config and sequence length should we target? Also where should we upload the artifacts?

maria (Marketing): Use model-id: open/model-x-8bit-quant (the one in the catalog). Sequence length target = 512 (typical for our demo). Upload to s3://redwood-marketing/bench-handoff/4332109876. I'll paste the 10 payloads in a sec — they cover short prompt, long context, embed-256, embed-1024, code, multi-turn chat, etc.

jen (Data Science): If possible, include per-slice breakdown: embed 256 vs 1024, and a cold-start heatmap (first 20 requests vs warmed). Marketing wants to show variability.

alex (Eng Runtime): Cool. Quantized embeddings can be finicky — we'll run both embed-only and generation traces. Warmup plan we propose: 5 warmup requests per prompt template, then measure over 100 requests per slice. Will that work?

maria (Marketing): Yes, that warmup plan works. We only need the condensed numbers and the raw traces for one representative seed per slice. Also include batching config used (batch size, max latency target).

runtime-bot: Job queued: bench-run-4332109876-quantized (id: 2345) — ETA depends on GPU availability.

alex (Eng Runtime): Upload path noted. I'll run: quantized generation (512), embed-256, embed-1024. I'll capture p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, cold vs warm percentiles, and a single full trace (including KV cache hit counts) per slice. ETA: EOD Wed if cluster stays healthy.

alex (Eng Runtime): Quick how-to repro snippet I'll include in the artifact (also pasting here):
```bash
# run a smoke sweep locally against staging runtime
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open/model-x-8bit-quant","input":["<payload>"],"max_tokens":512,"batching":{"max_batch_size":16}}'
```

maria (Marketing): Perfect, thanks. Please tag me in the S3 upload and drop the short summary (1 paragraph) we can paste into the blog. :rocket:

jen (Data Science): Also please include a CSV with per-request latency and a column for "warmup_pass" so we can compute sample-level variance.

alex (Eng Runtime): Will do. Adding p95 as well per Jen's ask. I'll attach the CSV + a readme describing columns.

maria (Marketing): One last ask — can you include a short note about any masking or prompt truncation you applied so we don't misrepresent the prompt lengths in the post?

alex (Eng Runtime): Yep — we'll include truncation rules and any prompt-normalization steps. I'll ping you when upload completes.

maria (Marketing): Awesome, thank you! :thumbsup:

alex (Eng Runtime): No problem — will update thread once artifacts are live.

runtime-bot: bench-run-4332109876-quantized started on gpu-pool-3 (job id 2345)
